info.album: The Very Best Of Sting And The Police

podcast.body: A "regified" 1979 UK number one hit by The Police. At the 2013 Grammy Awards, Bruno Mars and Sting directly segued into this song after performing "Locked Out of Heaven," making their musical connection and homage even more explicit. "segueing from locked out of heaven right into the police's even more regified 1979 UK number one hit, Walking On the Moon."

podcast.body: One of the first two number one singles from "Regatta de Blanc" in the UK, this song was characterized by its Dub Reggae style. "In the UK, the album's first two singles were both number 1 hits, the Dub Reggae style walking on the moon, and the Skah meets Post Punk message in a bottle."
